messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick Q from managers: were getting a bunch of midcycle promos + comp realigns. Folks asking about retro pay, approvals, and whether equity needs a separate request. Can we align on a one-pager checklist?
Marco Diaz (Manager): Thanks. Also need clarity on who signs off for market corrections vs. merit promos. Is comp-ops needed for market adjustments?
Nadia (Comp & Rewards): Yes  market corrections require comp-ops approval. Merit promos (on-cycle or small off-cycle increases under the manager budget) only need manager + People Ops signoff unless they push someone above band midpoint, then comp-ops reviews.
Rafael - Payroll: For payroll cutoffs: US = submit by EOD 2 business days before payroll date. APAC/EMEA vary by local vendor (usually 5 business days). If you miss the cutoff we process the change in the next run and file retro/backpay.
Marco Diaz (Manager): If we want an effective date in the past (retro), what justification do you need?
Nadia (Comp & Rewards): Short: manager business rationale + evidence (offer error, market data, missed calibration). For market correction retros, comp-ops approval is mandatory. Over 6 months retro needs Director sign-off.
Lena (Legal): Reminder: if salary is written into the employment contract, you must prepare a contract amendment, get the employee signature, and attach it to the ticket. Use the Legal amendment template in Confluence.
Aisha (People Ops): To keep things moving, please include the following in the HR ticket. Copy/paste allowed.
```
- Employee name + employee ID
- Manager name + date of approval
- Type of change (merit / market correction / promotion / temporary)
- New salary (annual) and new grade/band
- Effective date (yyyy-mm-dd)
- Signed comp change form (attach)
- Contract amendment (if compensation contractual)
- Employee acknowledgement (email or e-sign)
- Comp-ops approval (if market correction or off-band)
- Payroll region (US/EMEA/APAC) + local vendor email
- Retro justification (if effective date is in the past)
- Equity request ID (if requesting concurrent grant)
- Any budget notes or headcount flags
```
Marco Diaz (Manager): Great checklist. Whats the timeline for retro pay landing in employee bank? We have a North America hire who missed cutoff.
Rafael - Payroll: Typically processed the next payroll cycle after final signoff. For cross-border retros it can be 1-2 cycles due to tax reconciliation. We publish expected payment date in the ticket once payroll confirms.
Nadia (Comp & Rewards): One more nuance: equity grants are on a separate cadence. If you want a grant to align with the comp change, open a comp-ops ticket and reference the HR ticket ID. Grant vesting dates and grant sizes are handled separately.
Lena (Legal): Also watch for statutory notice or minimums in some countries when increasing pay. We coordinate with our local counsel for those markets.
Marco Diaz (Manager): Who should I tag to expedite a time-sensitive retro?
Aisha (People Ops): Tag @Nadia, @Rafael and @Lena in the ticket. Add "urgent-retro" in the subject and include payroll cutoff date. That helps triage.
people-bot: FYI payroll cutoff calendar is pinned in #people-ops/payschedule. Use the payroll calendar link when creating tickets.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all. Ill pin this checklist in the channel and add a short Confluence page with the retention of docs. If anyone wants a short TL;DR poster for managers I can make one. :thumbsup:
